report: Reassessed the complete claim: successful completed bodies contain neither live inference variables nor unresolved semantic choices; completion resolves type edges and returns a tree independent of temporary inference state. Verified exact byte equality of current infer_ctx.rs and representation_spec.rs against the supplied historical snapshots, and identical claim text. Prior rationale remains applicable, not an execution result. The sole ordinary implementation association is InferCtx::finish: it checks pending obligations, live branches/tasks/wakes, rejects unfilled expression slots, consumes temporary state and invokes finalization. Captured finalize.rs for additional context: finalization builds a fresh stash, recursively copies expressions/patterns/statements and type-bearing call/closure/alias edges, resolves root-version types, panics on surviving InferVar, and substitutes resolved expression slots. These mechanisms support the claim but are not by themselves exhaustive whole-tree verification. The complete associated test set consists only of sage_meta::todo::types_body_no_inference. Its empty body has no behavioral assertions; its explicit TODO reserves completion fixtures traversing the entire returned tree and rejecting live inference or unresolved choices. That prerequisite remains justified: representative completed-body fixtures plus recursive inspection of every returned type and choice edge are needed, including checking ownership after transient inference state is consumed. A missed nested edge would escape this placeholder, so no complete implementation/test guarantee is asserted. Accepting this declared verification gap preserves TODO status. No source edits or behavioral tests were run; personally executed review start, captured reads, exact comparisons, and review record. Coordinator-reported 321 sage-meta tests and cargo build are separate baseline execution, not personal verification. No further edits are needed to the existing deferred accounting.
